summary: Fixes for common problems when building AAPS with Android Studio: Gradle sync failures (uncommitted changes, git identity, JVM and Android Gradle plugin versions, offline mode, 32-bit Windows), false build warnings, and APK install problems, ending with a clean rebuild. Nearly all labels are Android Studio's or Gradle's; only Export settings and Import settings refer to AAPS.

sections.heading: Troubleshooting Android Studio
sections.summary: Page introduction.

sections.heading: Lost keystore
sections.summary: A lost keystore means uninstalling and reinstalling AAPS; links to the reinstall guide.

sections.heading: Gradle Sync failed
sections.summary: Finding the Gradle sync error in Android Studio's Build tab, then resyncing after the fix.

sections.heading: Uncommitted changes
sections.summary: The "uncommitted changes" Gradle error and the three steps that fix it.

sections.heading: Step 1 - Check git installation
sections.summary: Checking that git is installed and set up in Android Studio's version control settings.

sections.heading: Step 2: Check for uncommitted changes.
sections.summary: Finding and rolling back uncommitted files in Android Studio's Commit tab.

sections.heading: Step 3: Resync Gradle (again)
sections.summary: Resyncing Gradle after the fix.

sections.heading: Git Pull Failed - Please tell me who you are
sections.summary: Setting the git user name and e-mail in a terminal.

sections.heading: Incompatible Gradle JVM
sections.summary: Selecting or downloading the JDK version required for the AAPS version in Android Studio's Gradle settings.

sections.heading: Incompatible version of Android Gradle plugin
sections.summary: Updating an outdated Android Studio when the Android Gradle plugin version is not supported.

sections.heading: Could not resolve/No cached version
sections.summary: Turning off Gradle offline mode, then resyncing.

sections.heading: Unable to start daemon process
sections.summary: 32-bit Windows is not supported by Android Studio.

sections.heading: Gradle Resync
sections.summary: Retrying Gradle sync from the error message or reloading the Gradle project from the Gradle tab.

sections.heading: Generate Signed APK generated successfully with 0 build variants
sections.summary: The "0 build variants" message is a false warning; the APK is in the destination folder.

sections.heading: App was created with compiler/kotlin warnings
sections.summary: Compiler and Kotlin warnings can be ignored.

sections.heading: No CGM data is received by AAPS
sections.summary: Use BYODA instead of the patched Dexcom app; set up xDrip's receiver identification.

sections.heading: Apk not installed
sections.summary: When the phone refuses the APK: wrong keystore, or reinstalling with exported settings, Bluetooth off and airplane mode on.

sections.heading: Apk installed but old version
sections.summary: The version stays the same when the local copy of the code was not updated.

sections.heading: None of the above worked
sections.summary: Rebuilding the APK from scratch, reinstalling it and importing the exported settings.

sections.heading: Worst case scenario
sections.summary: Uninstalling Android Studio completely and starting over.
